source.method: Holes, greens, tees, bunkers and water from OpenStreetMap (API 0.6 map call, Oct 3 2026). Village and Mill hole lines re-routed down the turf corridor seen in aerial imagery (least-cost path tee to green over a turf/tree mask, kept near the OSM line and off neighbouring holes; Village 1 placed by hand). Woods (natural=wood) and fairways (golf=fairway, the turf corridor eroded 8 m) segmented automatically from the imagery within 75 m / 45 m of the hole lines. School hole lines are OSM as drawn. v2 (Oct 3, on course): woods re-segmented stricter (darker and more textured, 3.6 m clear of turf, pieces over ~430 m²) after cart paths and shaded rough read as trees.
source.imagery: Esri World Imagery z18 (~0.5 m/px), dormant-turf capture
source.caveat: Automatic segmentation, not a survey: tree edges within a few yards; shade on turf can read as trees; no OB.
source.woods: USGS 3DEP lidar point cloud (GA_Statewide_B3_2018, s3://usgs-lidar-public): every 1 m cell whose highest return stands 3 m or more above the bare earth and holds high-vegetation points, within 75 m of a hole line, off the mapped turf, bunkers and water (scripts/lidar-trees/, D133).

imagery.release: World Imagery Wayback release 49059: leaf-off, fewest shadows (R4, Brett Oct 10)

elevation.source: USGS 3DEP (elevation.nationalmap.gov 3DEPElevation ImageServer getSamples, bilinear; 1 m lidar where flown), via scripts/fetch-3dep.mjs

greenGrids.source: USGS 3DEP 1 m lidar (elevation.nationalmap.gov ImageServer getSamples, bilinear), via scripts/fetch-green-slopes.mjs
